parsed.vinification_summary: Penfolds employs its multi-regional, multi-vineyard blending approach for Bin 2, sourcing Shiraz and Mataro from selected vineyards. Using older oak avoids overwhelming the wine's medium-bodied frame with new oak flavors, instead focusing on subtle texture integration. This method, contrasted with the new oak used for flagship wines, is a deliberate cost and style decision for this tier.
food_pairing: Grilled lamb chops with rosemary and garlic — The wine's black pepper and smoked meat notes mirror the char and herbs, while its acidity cuts through the fat.
Mushroom and taleggio pizza — The earthy, umami depth of the mushrooms and cheese finds a partner in the wine's savory Monastrell character.
Braised beef short ribs — The wine's structure stands up to the rich, collagen-heavy dish, and its dark fruit complements the caramelized exterior.
